paper_title: Automated multilabel diagnosis on electrocardiographic images and signals

concerns_full.concern_text: Only 6 ECG abnormality classifications — practical value is limited. PhysioNet 2020 challenge involved 121 types. Should add more abnormalities.
How to validate accuracy of ECG labels for all 2.2M ECGs? Only two image formats and their shuffled versions — should include commonly used ECG-image standard formats from different countries.
Can image-based model extract ECG information like channel (I, II, V1 etc) or waveform features (QRS amplitude, heart rate)? Explainable feature outputs could enhance performance.

paper_title: Biomarker panels for improved risk prediction in atrial fibrillation

concerns_full.concern_text: Rationale for selecting these 12 biomarkers out of many candidates should be provided.
Independent risk factors for each outcome are different. Models adjusted for same covariates across all outcomes — should adjust specifically per outcome.

paper_title: AgentMD: Empowering language agents for risk prediction with large-scale clinical tool learning

concerns_full.concern_text: Tool correctness tested with GPT-4-generated unit tests. Should include manually crafted high-quality test cases by human experts, including extreme/boundary cases.
How can agent reliably create calculation functions from paper abstracts only? Calculation details are in the main body. Toolset creation pipeline not open-sourced.
Sending patient information to proprietary model API may leak private information — privacy concerns not discussed.

paper_title: Data-driven prediction of continuous renal replacement therapy survival

concerns_full.concern_text: Why 7 days chosen? Some patients have much shorter CRRT. Not stated that model is proof-of-principle — abstract and introduction suggest clinical use.
Figures use CCS codes instead of feature names. Run-on sentences throughout. Switches between past and present tense.
